{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: any row where revenue contains '999999.99' or '999,999.99'
# Since the data was exported via Excel, it may have commas
qa_mask = sales['revenue'].str.contains('999,999.99', na=False) | (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99')
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]

# Print the result
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999,999.99 or 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA order revenue values: {qa_orders["revenue"].unique()}')"}
